description: Builds (unless noBuild), zips and uploads the local build as a new version of an existing game (needs login; multipart, retried), then waits for the server autotest and returns the version state and its report. Use it after gamealia_run_autotest passes locally and gamealia_create_game. Each call creates a new version; interrupted uploads that block it are aborted automatically. Can take minutes (progress notifications). submit:true also submits it for review when the autotest passes: only after the user confirmed; otherwise use gamealia_submit_for_review later. When the game is already live (an update), submit:true needs notes: a short changelog of what changed, written from your work and confirmed with the user.

dir.description: Project folder (absolute, or relative to the server's working directory)

game.description: Game slug or id, from gamealia_list_games (a game of the active account)

noBuild.description: Skip the build command and upload the current output folder as is (default false: build first)

notes.description: Release notes: a short changelog of what changed in this version (new content, fixes, balance or control changes), 2000 characters max. The reviewer reads them first. REQUIRED (at least 10 characters) to submit an update to a game that is already live (liveVersionId set); optional for the first submission. Write them from the code diff or your own work since the live version, and confirm them with the user. Needed here when submit:true

submit.description: Also submit for review if the server autotest passes (only after the user confirms)

waitForPrevious.description: If a previous version is still being tested, wait for it instead of failing

name: gamealia_upload_version
title: Upload a new version
